headline: Bin Laden was killed, three Arab governments fell, and Siri shipped nine days after Steve Jobs died
texture: Netflix had twelve million DVD subscribers when it split the price of discs and streaming in July, charging $7.99 for each. In September it said the disc half would become a separate company called Qwikster, and in October it cancelled that plan after 800,000 subscribers quit. Spotify opened in the United States that same July with six months of free listening. Portal 2 shipped in April, Skyrim on November 11, and Minecraft left beta a week after that.

Apple announced the iPhone 4S on October 4 and sold four million of them in three days. Siri came with it, and talking to a phone in public was new enough to turn heads. Facebook counted 800 million users on September 22. Google+ opened on June 28, reached 25 million people inside a month, and finished the year near 90 million. Instagram had been out for a year and still ran on the iPhone only.

Unemployment sat at 9.1 percent in January and 8.5 percent in December, and nobody called the recession over. Congress passed the Budget Control Act on the August 2 deadline, and Standard and Poor's cut the US credit rating from AAA to AA+ three days later. Occupy Wall Street took Zuccotti Park on September 17, and police cleared it on November 15. Ben Ali left Tunisia in January, Mubarak resigned in February, and Gaddafi was killed at Sirte in October.

pol.us_president.label: US President
pol.us_president.detail: Third year of his first term, with Joe Biden as vice president.

pol.us_congress.label: US Congress
pol.us_congress.value: 112th Congress, Republican House and Democratic Senate
pol.us_congress.detail: John Boehner was Speaker with 242 Republican seats. Harry Reid led a Senate of 51 Democrats and 2 independents caucusing with them. The first split Congress since 2001.

pol.debt_ceiling.label: Debt ceiling standoff
pol.debt_ceiling.value: Budget Control Act signed on the deadline, then the first downgrade of the US credit rating
pol.debt_ceiling.detail: Signed August 2, the day default was projected. Standard and Poor's cut the rating from AAA to AA+ on August 5.

world.uk_pm.label: UK Prime Minister
world.uk_pm.detail: Leading a coalition with the Liberal Democrats, Nick Clegg as deputy.

event.bin_laden.label: Osama bin Laden killed
event.bin_laden.value: US special forces raid at Abbottabad, Pakistan
event.bin_laden.detail: May 2 local time. Obama announced it on the evening of May 1 in Washington.

event.tohoku.label: Tohoku earthquake and tsunami
event.tohoku.value: Magnitude 9.1 off northeastern Japan, followed by meltdowns at Fukushima Daiichi

event.arab_spring.label: Arab Spring
event.arab_spring.value: Ben Ali fled Tunisia on January 14 and Mubarak resigned in Egypt on February 11

event.gaddafi.label: Gaddafi killed
event.gaddafi.value: Captured and killed by National Transitional Council fighters at Sirte, Libya

event.occupy.label: Occupy Wall Street
event.occupy.value: Encampment in Zuccotti Park in the New York financial district
event.occupy.detail: Began September 17. Police in riot gear cleared the park on November 15 and arrested about 200 people.

event.iraq_withdrawal.label: US withdrawal from Iraq
event.iraq_withdrawal.value: The last 500 US troops crossed into Kuwait, ending the war
event.iraq_withdrawal.detail: A ceremony in Baghdad on December 15 marked the end of the mission. The final convoy left on December 18.

event.royal_wedding.label: Royal wedding
event.royal_wedding.value: Prince William married Catherine Middleton at Westminster Abbey

film.gross.label: Highest-grossing films, worldwide
value: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows Part 2
Pirates of the Caribbean: On Stranger Tides
The Twilight Saga: Breaking Dawn Part 1
film.gross.detail: Worldwide gross, from $1.34 billion for Deathly Hallows Part 2 down to $695 million for Ghost Protocol. The US domestic order differs.

film.best_picture.label: Best Picture
film.best_picture.detail: A silent, black and white French production, awarded at the ceremony the following February. Michel Hazanavicius took Best Director and Jean Dujardin Best Actor. Meryl Streep won Best Actress for The Iron Lady.

film.world_cinema.label: Nominated for Best Foreign Language Film

film.how_people_watched.label: How people watched
film.how_people_watched.value: Theatre, then disc, then streaming. Netflix charged $7.99 a month for each half after July and had twelve million subscribers on the disc side.

tv.top_shows.label: Most-watched programs, 2010 to 2011 season
tv.top_shows.detail: Nielsen reports by season rather than calendar year, so this is the season that ended in May.

tv.premieres.label: Game of Thrones premiered
tv.premieres.value: April 17 on HBO, averaging 2.52 million US viewers across the first season

music.hot100_year_end.label: Year-end Hot 100 number one
music.hot100_year_end.detail: Party Rock Anthem by LMFAO came second and Firework by Katy Perry third.

music.best_selling_album.label: Best-selling album
music.best_selling_album.detail: 18 million copies sold worldwide during the year. It reached North America on February 22.

music.listening_format.label: How people listened
music.listening_format.value: Spotify reached the United States in July with a six month ad-supported free tier. It had two million paying subscribers worldwide by September.

tech.iphone_4s.label: iPhone 4S
tech.iphone_4s.value: Announced October 4, on sale October 14, four million sold in three days
tech.iphone_4s.detail: Siri was exclusive to it. The s stood for Siri.

tech.netflix_qwikster.label: Qwikster
tech.netflix_qwikster.value: Netflix announced a separate DVD company in September and cancelled it in October
tech.netflix_qwikster.detail: July had already split the price, $7.99 for streaming and $7.99 for discs. 800,000 of twelve million subscribers quit.

tech.google_plus.label: Google+
tech.google_plus.value: Launched June 28, 10 million users in two weeks and about 90 million by the end of the year

tech.instagram.label: Instagram
tech.instagram.value: A year old and still iPhone only
tech.instagram.detail: Released October 2010 on iOS. A funding round in February valued it near $20 million.

tech.games.label: Games
value: The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim, November 11

prices.gas.label: Average US gas price
prices.gas.detail: Unleaded regular, US city average including taxes, annual average.

prices.unemployment.label: US unemployment rate
prices.unemployment.value: 9.1 percent in January, 8.5 percent in December
prices.unemployment.detail: At or above 9.0 percent for the first nine months of the year.

culture.mood.label: Mood
culture.mood.value: Third year of a recovery nobody could feel, with the debt fight in August and the Zuccotti Park encampment in September pulling opposite ways out of the same frustration.

sports.super_bowl.label: Super Bowl XLV
sports.super_bowl.detail: About 111 million US viewers, the most-watched US television program of any kind to that point.

sports.world_series.label: World Series
sports.world_series.value: St. Louis Cardinals beat the Texas Rangers, four games to three
sports.world_series.detail: Played October 19 to 28. Texas was one strike from the title twice in game six before David Freese homered in the eleventh.

deaths.jobs.label: Steve Jobs
deaths.jobs.detail: Tim Cook succeeded him as chief executive of Apple.

deaths.winehouse.label: Amy Winehouse
deaths.winehouse.value: Died July 23, aged 27, of alcohol poisoning

deaths.taylor.label: Elizabeth Taylor
deaths.taylor.detail: Two Academy Awards, and one of the first public figures to campaign on HIV and AIDS.

deaths.kim_jong_il.label: Kim Jong-il
deaths.kim_jong_il.value: Died December 17, reported as a heart attack on a train
deaths.kim_jong_il.detail: Succeeded by his youngest son, Kim Jong Un.

notes: Research pass July 2026. Dropped from the earlier draft: the top-websites fact, because Alexa rankings for 2011 survive only in archived snapshots nobody has assembled; the claim that Spotify was invite-only in the US, which its own article contradicts; and the claim that Jobs died six weeks after the iPhone 4S shipped, which is backwards, he died nine days before it went on sale. Box office is worldwide because that is what the source ranks. Nielsen figures are for the season ending May 2011, labelled as such.
